[Rating: 3/10] RPS fighting game where the gimmicks are very shallow and a instakill player elimination mechanic that is always present.  The layout of the cards is also not the best

[Rating: 3/10] wat een simplistisch spel.  Ook niet echt keuzemogelijkheden.  Je kiest in het begin je krijger en krijgt dan een setje van 6-8 kaarten.  Dan is het elke keer een kaart kiezen en zien of de tegenstander dit countert of niet. Tag team is dan veel beter alsook duel for cardia.  Dit spel lijkt niet te zijn gemaakt in 2025.

[Rating: 4/10] It's rock paper scissor, but there very few meaningful game states, and very few variables to base your guess on (unlike Exceed or Yomi2)

[Rating: 4/10] Played on BGA.  Rock paper scissors with some characters I don't know anything about.  Randomness, but at least it's real fast.

[Rating: 5/10] I will say this game reminds me of every other 2-plaeyr dueling card game. I can appreciate the ease of play and how quick you can start playing, but it doesn't feel unique. It will work for many, but for me it was only ok.

[Rating: 5/10] Very simple card fighting game. It is like 5 minutes long and has some decent deduction. For what it is its fine but I think the depth is non existent despite lots of characters.
